answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation: each identity periodically receives two isolated branches seeded with random terrain labels (e.g., trellis vs mesa) and a random pigment; it must return divergent signed state-root transcripts. A cloned agent copied from one master cannot answer both branches without forking its state, and cross-checks reject identical responses. Attacker cost: one independently executed, stateful agent per sybil—separate CPU, storage, and maintenance—not one replicated master.
